# Consiglio's Kitchenware

> > Consiglio's Kitchenware is a specialty retailer offering authentic Italian and European kitchen equipment, including Fabio Leonardi food processors, pasta makers, espresso makers, and replacement parts for professional-grade kitchenware.

The store specializes in premium Italian brands from Bologna and across Europe, featuring Fabio Leonardi motors and attachments (MR10, MR0), Giannini espresso makers, Imperia pasta machines, La Patisserie bakeware, and Ilsa cookware. They provide both complete appliances and hard-to-find replacement parts for professional and home cooks seeking authentic European kitchen equipment.

## Key Topics

- Fabio Leonardi food processors and motors
- Italian replacement parts
- MR10 motor system
- Meat grinders and attachments
- Tomato mills and food processing
- Stainless steel construction
- Made in Italy kitchenware
- Pasta making equipment
- Espresso makers (Giannini, stovetop)
- La Patisserie bakeware (PTFE/PFOA free)
- Bologna manufacturing
- Professional food processing
- Imperia pasta machines
- Niploy cast iron attachments
- European cookware (Italy, Spain)
